# Introduction

Differential accessibility analysis was performed using the [limma-voom pipeline](https://doi.org/10.1186/gb-2014-15-2-r29) to identify peaks that were differentially accessible between the treatment groups. 

```{r setup,include=F,echo=FALSE}
options(bitmapType='cairo')
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplotify)
library(ggvenn)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(formatR)
library(edgeR)
library(Rsubread)
library(downloadthis)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = F,
  dpi = 150,
  error=FALSE,
  warning = F,
  dev = c("png","pdf"),
  message = F)
```

```{r setup2,warning=F,include=F}
#Create directories for analysis
analysis.path<-"output/"
if(!dir.exists(analysis.path))
  dir.create(analysis.path,showWarnings = T,recursive = T)
analysis.tables<-file.path("docs/tables/")
if(!dir.exists(analysis.tables))
  dir.create(analysis.tables, recursive = T)
plots.dir <- file.path("docs/plots/")
if(!dir.exists(plots.dir))
  dir.create(plots.dir, recursive = T)
source("code/globalfun.R")
```

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = plots.dir)
# custom hook: after each plot chunk, append a download link
knitr::knit_hooks$set(
  plot = function(x, options) {
    xx <- gsub("png$", "pdf", x)
    fig_link <- xfun::embed_file(xx, text = paste0("Download ", basename(xx)))
    paste0(knitr::hook_plot_md(x, options), "\n\n", fig_link, "\n")
  }
)
```

# Read Summarisation

Summarisation of reads to peaks was performed using *featureCounts* a function from **Rsubread** implemented in the NFCore/ATAC pipeline.

```{r, fig.height=10,fig.width=12, fig.cap="featureCounts: Assignments", echo=F}
ggplot(fcounts.stats, aes(
  x = Sample, y = Reads,fill=Stats)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() + 
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "# Reads",
       fill= "Stats") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Reads/1000000,2),"M")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 12 
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12 
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.8)
  )
```

source ~/.bashrc

annotatePeaks.pl ${workdir}/output/NFCore_ATACseq/bwa/merged_library/macs2/narrow_peak/consensus/consensus_peaks.mLb.clN.bed  hg38 -cpu 6 > \

```{r,eval=FALSE}
suppressMessages(library(org.Hs.eg.db))
fcounts <- read.table(
  "output/NFCore_ATACseq//bwa/merged_library/macs2/narrow_peak/consensus/consensus_peaks.mLb.clN.featureCounts.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  header = T
)
annotation.info <- read.delim(
  "output/NFCore_ATACseq//bwa/merged_library/macs2/narrow_peak/consensus/consensus_peaks.mLb.clN.annotatePeaks2.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  header = T
)
annotation.info$Annotation2 <- unlist(lapply(annotation.info$Annotation, 
    function(y) trimws(strsplit(y, "\\(")[[1]][1])))
colnames(annotation.info)[1] <- "PeakID"
dge <- DGEList(fcounts,
               annotation.columns = c("Geneid", "Chr", "Start", "End", "Strand", "Length"))
colnames(dge)<-gsub(".mLb.*","",colnames(dge))
dge<-dge[,gsub("_T1","",sample.sheet$sample)]
rownames(dge)<-dge$genes$Geneid
dge$genes <- cbind(dge$genes, annotation.info[match(dge$genes$Geneid, annotation.info$PeakID), -c(1:5)])
save(dge, file = "output/dge.RData")
```

# Differential peak analysis

To understand the differences in peak accessibility, the [limma-voom pipeline](https://doi.org/10.1186/gb-2014-15-2-r29) for differential analysis was used.

## Design matrix

The 'group' column from Table 1 was used to generate the design matrix, as required for the limma pipeline.

```{r}
sample.sheet$group<-factor(sample.sheet$group)
design.matrix <- model.matrix( ~ 0+group, sample.sheet)
colnames(design.matrix) <- gsub("-", "_", gsub(
  "group", "", colnames(design.matrix)))
min.samples <- min(colSums(design.matrix))
design.matrix
```

\FloatBarrier

## Peak filtering

Peaks were excluded from further analysis if they did not satisfy the following conditions;

\begin{itemize}
\item did not have a cpm count \>= `r cpm.filt` in at least `r min.samples` libraries
\end{itemize}

```{r}
is.pred <- grepl("^GM", dge$genes$Gene.Name)
```

```{r}
is.not_validID <- is.na(dge$genes$Entrez.ID) | is.na(dge$genes$Gene.Name) ==
"NA"
```

```{r}
is.standard_Chr <- dge$genes$Chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:23,
"X", "Y"))
```


```{r cpm-expression-violin,fig.height=8,fig.width=8, fig.cap="Distribution of peak expression (cpm) across samples"}
cpm.exp<-cpm(dge) %>% as.data.frame() %>% pivot_longer(cols = colnames(dge),
               names_to = "Sample",
               values_to = "cpm") %>% mutate(group = gsub("_REP.*","",Sample))
ggplot(cpm.exp, aes(x = Sample, y = cpm, fill=group)) +
  geom_violin() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "cpm") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cpm.filt,
             color = "grey80",
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 12 
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12 
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

```

```{r}
is.expr <- rowSums(cpm(dge) >= cpm.filt) >= min.samples
table(is.expr)
keep.peaks<-!is.pred & !is.not_validID & is.standard_Chr &
is.expr
table(keep.peaks)
```

```{r}
#Perform filter
dgl.exp <- dge[keep.peaks, , keep.lib.size = FALSE]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
cat("Number of peaks before filter:",format(nrow(dge),big.mark = ","),"\n")
cat("Number of peaks after filter:",format(nrow(dgl.exp),big.mark = ","),"\n")
```

\FloatBarrier


## Voom transformation and normalisation

```{r}
norm.method<-"quantile"
```

The read counts were transformed using the *voom* function within **limma** and then `r ifelse(norm.method=="none", "Library size",norm.method)` normalised as shown by the mean-variance trend estimated from the data in the plot below.

```{r voom-norm, fig.height=6,fig.width=8, fig.cap="Voom: Mean - Variance trend plot"}
par(cex.main = 0.8,
    cex.axis = 0.6,
    cex.lab = 0.7)
y <- voom(
  dgl.exp,
  design = design.matrix,
  plot = TRUE,
  normalize.method = norm.method,
)
```

\FloatBarrier

```{r barplot-distr-,fig.cap="Distribution of peak expression post normalisation", fig.width=7,fig.height=5}

boxplot(

)
```

## Linear modelling

A linear model was fitted to each peak, and empirical Bayes moderated t-statistics used to assess differences in accessibility.

```{r}
fit = lmFit(y, design = design.matrix)
fit.sav <- with(fit, cbind(genes, coefficients[
  , 1:length(unique(sample.sheet$group))]))

fit.sav_path<-file.path(analysis.tables, "ATACseq-condition-level-fitted-expression.xlsx")

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  fit.sav,
  file = fit.sav_path)
```

\FloatBarrier

```{r}
generate_datatable(fit.sav,show.rownames = F,caption="Summary of fitted expression values for each peak across conditions")
```


**Contrast design**

The following comparisons were made for each of the Histone markers;

```{r}
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(
    Healthy.vs.Patient=Healthy - Patient,
    levels = colnames(design.matrix)
)
```

`r paste0("**",colnames(contrast.matrix),"**",collapse=", ")`

Peaks were called differentially accessible if they achieved a False Discovery Rate of `r FDR.cutoff` using the global method wtihin the decideTests function within the limma package.

```{r}
fit.contrast<-contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts = contrast.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit.contrast)
fold_change.path<-file.path(analysis.tables, "ATACseq-peaks-merged-logFC.xlsx")
openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  with(fit2, cbind(genes, coefficients)),
  file = fold_change.path
)
```

```{r}
generate_datatable(with(fit2, cbind(genes, coefficients)),show.rownames = F,caption="Summary of logFC values for each peak across comparisons")
```

\FloatBarrier

```{r}
include_file_download(path2file = fold_change.path,
  filename = "ATACseq-peaks-merged-logFC.xlsx")
```


```{r}
dt.all <- decideTests(fit2, p.value = FDR.cutoff)
summary(dt.all)
```

```{r plotUpsetPeaks,fig.cap="Upset plot showing the number of DARs shared across all comparisons", fig.height=10,fig.width=10}

  UpSetR::fromList(peaks.venn),

  nintersects = nintersects,
  # Number of intersections to show
  sets = names(peaks.venn),
  # Names of the sets
  order.by = "freq",
  # Order by frequency of intersections
  decreasing = TRUE,
  # Sort intersections in decreasing order
  mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
  # Adjust the ratio of matrix bars to set size bars
  text.scale = 1.2,
  # Adjust text size
  mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size",
  # Y-axis label for intersection sizes

)
pdf(paste0(plts.path,"/Upset-all-DA-peaks-no-direction.pdf"), height = 8,width = 14)

dev.off()
print(upset_all)
```

## Heatmap of Differential Accessible Peaks

```{r, echo=FALSE}
heatplots.dir <- file.path(plts.path, "/Heatmaps/")
if (!dir.exists(heatplots.dir))
  dir.create(heatplots.dir, recursive = T)
plotHeatmap <-
  function(heat.data,
           margin = c(15, 3),
           lhei = c(0.3, 4),
           dendrogram = T,
           cexCol = 0.9,
           labRow = NA,
           colRow = "black",
           cexRow = 0.8,
           main = "Heatmap",
           Colv = T,
           plot.name,
           out.width = 8,
           out.height = 16,
           cex.main = 1,
           key.genes = T,
           ...)
  {
    rowCols <- rep("black", nrow(heat.data))
    if (key.genes)
      rowCols[match(genes.hlight, rownames(heat.data))] <- "purple"
    dendrogram = ifelse(dendrogram, "both", "row")
    linkage.col = ifelse(Colv, "complete", "none")
    for (i in 1:2)
    {
      if (i == 1)
        pdf(
          paste0(heatplots.dir, plot.name, ".pdf"),
          width = out.width,
          height = out.height,
          useDingbats = F
        )
      par(cex.main = cex.main)
      coolmap(
        heat.data,
        lhei = lhei,
        show.dendrogram = dendrogram,
        main = main,
        linkage.col = linkage.col,
        cexCol = cexCol,
        cexRow = cexRow,
        colRow = rowCols,
        ...
      )
      if (i == 1)
        dev.off()
    }
  }
```

\FloatBarrier

The heatmap below shows the expression pattern of a selected top differentially detected peaks in `r colnames(contrast.matrix)`.

```{r, fig.cap="Heatmap of the top DA peaks in HL_HL.vs.HL_LL", fig.height=15, fig.width=10,message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
heat.data <- y[rownames(top.de$HL_HL.vs.HL_LL), ]
rownames(heat.data) <- heat.data$genes$Gene.Name

## Volcano plots

The volcano plots below show the distribution of differentially accessible peaks in `r paste0(comps.interest, collapse=", ")`.

```{r, echo=F}
down.col <- "steelblue"
up.col <- "orange"
no.de_col<-"lightgray"
plot.volcalno <-
  function(fit,
           coef = 1L,
           style = "p-value",
           highlight.top = 0L,
           highlight = NULL,
           names = fit$genes$Gene.Name,
           hl.col = down.col,
           xlab = "Log2 Fold Change",
           de.status = NULL,
           ylab = NULL,
           pch = 21,
           cex = 0.6,
           s = 1 / 50,
           xmax,
           ymax,
           ...)
  {
    if (!is(fit, "MArrayLM"))
      stop("fit must be an MArrayLM")
    x <- as.matrix(fit$coef)[, coef]
    style <- match.arg(tolower(style), c("p-value", "b-statistic"))
    if (style == "p-value") {
      if (is.null(fit$p.value))
        stop("No p-values found in linear model fit object")
      y <- as.matrix(fit$p.value)[, coef]
      y <- -log10(y)
      if (is.null(ylab))
        ylab = "-log10(P-value)"
    }
    else {
      if (is.null(fit$lods))
        stop("No B-statistics found in linear model fit object")
      y <- as.matrix(fit$lods)[, coef]
      if (is.null(ylab))
        ylab = "Log Odds of Differential Accession"
    }
    point.cols <- rep(no.de_col,nrow(de.status))
    if (!is.null(de.status) & all(rownames(fit) == rownames(de.status)))
    {
      point.cols[de.status[, coef]==-1] <- down.col
      point.cols[de.status[, coef]==1] <- up.col
    }
      
    bg.cols <- point.cols
    i <- NULL
    if (highlight.top > 0 & is.null(highlight)) {
      if (is.null(names))
        names <- 1:length(x)
      names <- as.character(names)
      o <- order(y, decreasing = TRUE)
      i <- o[1:highlight.top]
    }
    else if (!is.null(highlight))
    {
      i <- match(highlight, fit$genes$Geneid, nomatch = 0)
      if (highlight.top > 0)
      {
        o <- order(y, decreasing = TRUE)
        i <- o[1:highlight.top]
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(i))
    {
      point.cols[i] <- hl.col
      cex <- rep(cex, nrow(fit))
      cex[i] <- cex[i] + 0.2
    }
    plot(
      x,
      y,
      xlab = xlab,
      ylab = ylab,
      pch = pch,
      cex = cex,
      col = point.cols,
      bg = bg.cols,
      ...
    )
    limits <- par("usr")
    if (!is.null(i) & !is.null(names))
    {
        basicPlotteR::addTextLabels(
        xCoords = x[i],
        yCoords = y[i],
        labels = names[i],
        cex.label = 0.7,
        #col.label = bg.cols[i],
        col.line = "grey50"
      )
      
    }
  }
plts.volcano<-paste0(plts.path,"/Volcano_plots/")
if(!dir.exists(plts.volcano))
  dir.create(plts.volcano,recursive = T)

plot.save_volcano <- function(name, fig.height, fig.width, symbols, ...)
{
  name <-
    paste0(plts.volcano,name)
  for (plt in c("unlabelled", "labelled", "normal"))
  {
    nn = symbols
    if (plt == "unlabelled")
      nn = NULL
    if (plt != "normal")
      pdf(
        paste0(name, "_", plt, ".pdf"),
        height = fig.height,
        width = fig.width,
        useDingbats = F
      )
    plot.volcalno(names = nn, ...)
    if (plt != "normal")
      dev.off()
  }
  
}
```

## All Code used in this analysis

```{r appendix, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Get all chunk labels in the document
labels <- knitr::all_labels()

# Exclude this specific chunk so it doesn't print its own generation code
labels <- labels[labels != "appendix"]

# Loop through each label, print a markdown header, and then the code block
for (label in labels) {
  # Print the header (you can change the #### to adjust the heading size)
  cat("#### Chunk: `", label, "`\n\n", sep = "")
  
  # Print the opening of the code block
  cat("```r\n")
  
  # Fetch and print the actual code from the chunk
  cat(knitr::knit_code$get(label), sep = "\n")
  
  # Print the closing of the code block
  cat("\n```\n\n")
}
```
